title: Free guitar tuner and metronome in your browser — no app, no ads, no subscription
description: A chromatic tuner with presets for guitar, bass, ukulele, violin and more, plus a precise metronome with tap tempo, time signatures and subdivisions. Runs in your browser using the microphone on your device; nothing is recorded or uploaded. Once the page is open it needs no connection. A free alternative to GuitarTuna and Pro Metronome.
